title: Mom said dinner is at seven, but I'm hungry now!
scene: 妈妈说七点吃饭，他现在就饿。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Mom said dinner is at seven, but I'm hungry now!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You just had a snack, remember?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Mom said I could only have a small one!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It was small... for a tiger!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Ha! Dinner is still at seven, little tiger.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Can I have just one tiny bite?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Go ask Mom — she's the dinner boss!
